[Section] Usage Notes
[source_id=23] As this corpus of annotated patient notes comprises original healthcare data which contains protected health information (PHI) per The Health Information Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) BIBREF16 and can be joined to the MIMIC-III database, individuals who wish to access to the data must satisfy all requirements to access the data contained within MIMIC-III. To satisfy these conditions, an individual who wishes to access the database must take a “Data or Specimens Management” course, as well as sign a user agreement, as outlined on the MIMIC-III database webpage, where the latest version of this database will be hosted as “Annotated Clinical Texts from MIMIC” BIBREF17. This corpus can also be accessed on GitHub after completing all of the above requirements.
